title: Sylph environment protocol v1
description: Length-delimited JSON for exact capture uploads, durable terminal receipts, and operational controls. Trace semantics are mapped from retained evidence on the server; legacy semantic event messages are absent.

code.description: On a rejection: one of the RejectCode spellings in crates/protocol/src/env.rs, e.g. AGENT_UNAVAILABLE, WORKDIR_OUTSIDE_ROOTS, SESSION_NOT_HOSTED, POLICY_VIOLATION, FILE_NOT_FOUND. The server maps each to one HTTP error and never classifies by message text.

agents.description: The envagent's agent inventory changed while connected. Not sequenced through the spool: it is current state about the machine, and a reconnect re-reports it in hello.
